notes:
How to read the file: the dataset covers 56 countries. TR and PE have lines: [] (emergency number only, no crisis line confirmed). EG, MA and PH are left out entirely (see omitted). Where free is null, the source did not say, or the number is charged at a normal or shared-cost rate. Where hours is not 24/7, show the hours in the UI. Several lines are not 24/7: RO ARPS (Fri–Sun 19:00–07:00 only), LU, SI Klic v duševni stiski, EE, DK, MT Richmond, CY, NZ Suicide Crisis Helpline, AR, VN, UA, MY HEAL 15555 and ID.
Recent changes: PT launched the 1411 National Suicide Prevention Line on 10 Sep 2025 (within SNS 24). NL: calling 113 became free in Oct 2025, and 0800-0113 still works. NZ Lifeline (0800 543 354 / 0508 828 865 / text 4357) has run only 07:00–midnight since Nov 2025. US and CA: 988 (call or text). KR: 109 replaced the old dispersed lines (incl. 1393) from Jan 2024. SG: national mindline 1771 launched 18 Jun 2025. HK: 18111 launched 27 Dec 2023. UA: Lifeline Ukraine 7333 is currently PAUSED (see omitted).
116 123 is the EU-harmonised emotional-support number, but it is not a guaranteed 24/7 crisis line everywhere. It is included only where the operator was confirmed: GB/IE Samaritans, DE, CZ, SI, HU, PL, LT, LV, EE (10:00–24:00), NO. It is NOT confirmed for RO.
Dialing caveats: CL *4141 contains '*' (tel:*4141 works on mobiles, but it breaks the digits-only rule). ID 119 needs extension 8 after connecting. PT 808 24 24 24 needs menu option 4. AR 135 works only from Buenos Aires City and Greater Buenos Aires; use 0800 345 1435 elsewhere. CO Línea 106 is Bogotá only. AE 800-SAKINA is Abu Dhabi's DoH line. Text-only lines (GB Shout, IE 50808, US Crisis Text Line) have phone/tel null and the number in sms. For SG, SOS CareText is WhatsApp 9151 1767 and mindline is WhatsApp +65 6669 1771 (not SMS).
Emergency: one dialable number per country. GB 999 (112 also works). NO 113 = ambulance (112 = police). ZA 112 = mobile (10177 ambulance, 10111 police). AE 998 = ambulance (999 police). VN 115 = ambulance. IL 101 = MDA. CH 112 (144 ambulance). BR 192 = SAMU. CL 131 = SAMU. PE 106 = SAMU. For EU countries the source is the EC 112 page. MT 1579 is described as a 24hr free national line in the health.gov.mt search snippet, but that page returned 403; the number itself was confirmed on hpdp.gov.mt. Lifeline Taiwan 1995 hours are not stated on its site. ERAN (IL) hours were not confirmed on the page fetched.
